import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
california = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[
    [-124.4, 42.0], [-114.1, 42.0], [-114.1, 32.5], [-124.4, 32.5]
]])

# Time periods
april_2017_start = '2017-04-01'
april_2017_end = '2017-04-30'
august_2012_start = '2012-08-01'
august_2012_end = '2012-08-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition
dataset = 'ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/MONTHLY'
band = 'volumetric_soil_water_layer_1'

# April 2017
col_april = ee.ImageCollection(dataset) \
    .filterBounds(california) \
    .filterDate(april_2017_start, april_2017_end) \
    .select(band)

# August 2012
col_august = ee.ImageCollection(dataset) \
    .filterBounds(california) \
    .filterDate(august_2012_start, august_2012_end) \
    .select(band)

# Check collection sizes
size_april = col_april.size().getInfo()
size_august = col_august.size().getInfo()

print(f"April 2017 Images: {size_april}")
print(f"August 2012 Images: {size_august}")

if size_april == 0 or size_august == 0:
    # No fallback dataset for soil moisture in GEE that covers 2012 and 2017
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get monthly mean image (each collection should have 1 image)
    img_april = col_april.mean()
    img_august = col_august.mean()

    # Compute mean soil moisture over California
    scale = 10000  # ERA5-Land resolution ~11km
    reducer = ee.Reducer.mean()

    stats_april = img_april.reduceRegion(
        reducer=reducer,
        geometry=california,
        scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band)

    stats_august = img_august.reduceRegion(
        reducer=reducer,
        geometry=california,
        scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band)

    # Get pixel count to ensure valid data
    count_reducer = ee.Reducer.count()
    count_april = img_april.reduceRegion(
        reducer=count_reducer,
        geometry=california,
        scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band).getInfo()

    count_august = img_august.reduceRegion(
        reducer=count_reducer,
        geometry=california,
        scale=scale,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(band).getInfo()

    print(f"April 2017 Valid Pixels: {count_april}")
    print(f"August 2012 Valid Pixels: {count_august}")

    if count_april == 0 or count_august == 0:
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        val_april = stats_april.getInfo()
        val_august = stats_august.getInfo()

        print(f"April 2017 Mean Soil Moisture: {val_april:.4f} m³/m³")
        print(f"August 2012 Mean Soil Moisture: {val_august:.4f} m³/m³")

        # Validation: soil moisture should be between 0 and 0.6 m³/m³ typically
        if val_april is None or val_august is None or \
           val_april > 0.6 or val_august > 0.6 or \
           val_april < 0 or val_august < 0:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # Compare: increase means April 2017 > August 2012
            if val_april > val_august:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
